bane_of_arthropods: Increases damage against arthropods such as Spiders and Silverfish.
binding_curse: Prevents the cursed item from being removed from an armor slot.
breach: Increases the effectiveness of attacks against armored targets.
channeling: Allows the trident to summon lightning bolts during thunderstorms.
density: Increases attack damage based on your fall distance.
efficiency: Increases mining speed of the tool.
feather_falling: Reduces fall damage and ender pearl teleportation damage.
fire_aspect: Causes additional fire damage when used to attack a mob.
flame: Arrows fired from the bow will deal additional fire damage.
fortune: Some blocks like coal and diamond ore may drop additional items.
frost_walker: Water under the user will freeze into frosted ice.
knockback: Increases the knockback strength of the weapon.
looting: Mobs will drop more loot when killed.
loyalty: Allows the trident to automatically return after being thrown.
luck_of_the_sea: Increases the chance of getting good loot while fishing.
lunge: The user lunges forward when using the spear.
lure: Decreases the amount of time it takes for a fish to bite the hook.
mending: Repairs the durability of armor and tools with XP.
multishot: Fires additional arrows in similar directions.
piercing: Allows projectiles to pierce through mobs.
power: Increases the damage of arrows fired from the bow.
punch: Increases the knockback strength of arrows fired by the bow.
quick_charge: Increases the reload speed of crossbows.
respiration: Allows the user to breathe longer underwater.
riptide: Using the trident while in rain or water will launch the user forward.
sharpness: Increases the damage of the item.
silk_touch: Allows fragile blocks such as glass to be collected.
smite: Increases damage against undead mobs such as Zombies and Skeletons.
soul_speed: Increases movement speed on soul blocks.
sweeping_edge: Increases the damage of sweeping attacks.
vanishing_curse: Destroys the cursed item if you die with it in your inventory.
wind_burst: Smash attacks will launch the user back into the air.
